description: This Java class 'ClientApiConstants' defines a set of constant string values used throughout the project for identifying API resource names, actions, query parameters, request parameters, response parameters, and other related identifiers within the client API module of the Fineract project.

classes.name: ClientApiConstants
classes.description: A class containing a comprehensive collection of string constants used as identifiers for API resources, actions, request and response parameters related to client operations.
